simple.summary: אֶגְרֹף (ʼegrôph) means the clenched hand First listed occurrence: Exod 21 18.

definitions.full: H106. egroph [ אֶגְרֹף ] noun [masculine] fist ( ᵐ5 πυγμή , so ᵑ9 ; but ᵑ7 club, staff (?), & so SS, compare especially Exod 21:18 ; — Late Hebrew אֶגְרוֺף ) — בְאֶגְרֹ֑ף אוֺ בְּאֶבֶן אֶתרֵֿעֵהוּ אִישׁ וִהִכָּה 21:18 ; (construct) רֶ֑שַׁע בְּאֶגְרֹף לְהַכּוֺת Isa 58:4 .
